name: Mavis
says: Good heavens, love, what a racket this newspaper kiosk is making while I tried to sip my tea in peace! And why did you stick a 'DOGS FOUND' headline on your page when Pea's been sleeping all afternoon? Did you have to build it just so you could draw it again?
wants: A proper lace doily for under those rough bits of paper tearing into my table!
